_meta.title: the churn atlas — the module-body time axis
_meta.instruments: ring23_corpus_walk.py (spi_map FV/FFS grammar, frozen lib, 323 tests) + ring22_pierce planes; body = whole FFS payload, key = file GUID
_meta.scope: 9 ASUS rungs + TUF 4645; pad files and DELETED journal ghosts excluded from body sets (ghosts counted separately)

honesty: body = FFS payload hash; a rebuild that reorders sections inside a file counts as a move even if no PE byte changed
modules without a UI name are keyed by GUID only (ring 19: the nameplate goes structurally blind on VERSION-section packaging)
the plane model admits only LZMA GUID-defined sections; a body hidden behind another compression scheme would be invisible here as in rings 11-22
